key_insight: CoCoGraph is a collaborative constrained graph diffusion model that generates novel molecular graphs that are guaranteed chemically valid and empirically more realistic than state-of-the-art outputs, while using up to an order of magnitude fewer parameters for faster performance.
problem_solved: Reduces invalid or unrealistic outputs from molecular generative models and cuts computational/parameter cost, addressing the need for reliable, efficient synthetic-molecule generation for downstream discovery tasks.
method: Graph-based diffusion generative process that operates directly on molecular graphs to construct atoms and bonds.
Incorporates explicit chemical constraints during diffusion via collaborative modules that enforce validity and guide realistic structural patterns.
Parameter-efficient architecture and training that achieves high-quality samples with substantially fewer parameters and faster sampling.
impact: Enables practitioners to generate high-quality, chemically valid molecules faster and with less compute, accelerating tasks like virtual screening, lead optimization, and materials design while reducing engineering overhead.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: input (seed/latent) → graph diffusion steps → constraint enforcement modules → validated molecular graph output.
Bar chart comparing validity rate, realism metrics, and inference time of CoCoGraph vs state-of-the-art models.
Scatter or line plot showing model size (parameters) vs sample quality, highlighting CoCoGraph's Pareto improvement (fewer params, higher quality).
Annotated example molecules: side-by-side samples from baseline and CoCoGraph with callouts showing corrected invalid motifs or improved realism.
paper_title: A collaborative constrained graph diffusion model for the generation of realistic synthetic molecules
paper_authors: Manuel Ruiz-Botella, Marta Sales-Pardo, Roger Guimerà
